findings: Static 3D tilt, not mouse-reactive — The card's perspective transform is hardcoded to rotateY(-8deg) rotateX(4deg) (line 349-350). CREVO-style cards typically respond to mouse position. Add mouse tracking with useMotionValue and useTransform to make the tilt dynamic.

No parallax scroll effect — The original scattered cards had scroll-based depth effects. The new card animates on mount but doesn't respond to scroll. Consider adding useScroll and useTransform from framer-motion to create depth as the user scrolls past the hero.

Fixed max-width may not scale well — The card uses max-w-lg (~32rem/512px), which is appropriate for the 5-column span, but if viewport width exceeds ~1400px the card stops growing while the container continues expanding, creating asymmetry. Not a blocking issue for typical desktop resolutions, but worth monitoring.
